title: Paper 1 is a bounded formalization study
claim: Paper 1 formalizes the source-bounded Zhongzhou-school knowledge system into a traceable, auditable representation; it does not establish real-world predictive or causal validity.
maturity_note: Explicitly stated by the accepted project constitution, decision log, outline and manuscript framing. This records scope, not completion of every planned implementation.
wording_ceiling: The project specifies and evaluates a source-grounded formalization within the stated corpus. Do not claim the system has proven Zi Wei Dou Shu predictive validity.

evidence_refs.label: Manuscript v0.1 snapshot
evidence_refs.note: Working manuscript only; not independent evidence of its own quantitative statements.

limitations: Full corpus closure and all evaluation items have separate status.
The current manuscript is a working snapshot, not independent validation.
